limits: Serverpod Cloud rolls a new server in before the old one stops, and the reveal row does not record which server ran it. What this proves: a restart happened 39 s before the reveal time and the reveal still fired on time, from the database. The exactly-once reveal across a restart is also covered by the integration test 'when the reveal runs twice (schedule + host, or a restart)'.
